fields.label: Type d'étude
fields.quote: In particular, in our experiments we will ensemble the two most zero-shot effective LLMs and the BERT-based method we use as a comparative baseline.

fields.label: Données
fields.value: CLEF TAR datasets et Seed Collection dataset.
fields.quote: We experiment on the CLEF TAR datasets and the Seed Collection dataset.

fields.label: Modèles
fields.value: Les auteurs ont utilisé une série de modèles LLM zéro‑shot pour évaluer leur efficacité dans le dépistage automatique des documents de revue systématique.
fields.quote: We employ an array of zero-shot generative LLMs that differ in architecture, training steps, and size (model parameters) to extensively evaluate their effectiveness for automatic systematic review document screening.

fields.label: Résultats
fields.value: LlaMa2-7b-ins consistently obtains higher recall: 70% of topics achieved perfect recall, compared to only 50% using the other calibration method.
fields.quote: LlaMa2-7b-ins consistently obtains higher recall: 70% of topics achieved perfect recall, compared to only 50% using the other calibration method.
